# Community Night Space

Our first project is to set up a night space for socializing in Ballina. This would provide an community based, not-for-profit alternative to commercial nightclubs and late bars. The project can be considered to broadly fall within the purview of the recent government initiative to improve Irish nightlife in general. [The main NCF proposal](/proposal.html) has more details on this.

Update: We have a venue!

## Objectives

- Art based nightspot for post-pub socializing.
- Open-minded, tolerant, safe, welcoming environment for all.
- Dedicated venue for artists visiting North Mayo / West Sligo.

## Activities

The main purpose of the space is to facilitate socializing at night but as a member of THENCF any activity that has an arts and social element will be considered.

- Film nights
- Poetry and literature readings
- Live music
- Djs
- Practice
- Dance
- Workshops
- Installations
- Classes

## Location

Mayo County Council have kindly provided us with a home in Ballina at no 5 Pearse St, F26 C925.

## Volunteers Needed

We are looking for volunteers with practical or artistic skills (or both) to help us fix up and decorate the venue. All ideas considered, no budget too low.

A little prior art:

![sameheadz](sameheads.jpg)
![loophole](loophole.jpg)
![sowieso](space/sowieso01.jpg)

Don't like? No problem. It's a blank canvas, bring your vision.

## Donations

We are a member of the [Mayo PPN](https://mayoppn.ie/about-mayo-ppn/) but we welcome additional donations of any kind to support the project. Stuff we need:

- money
- furniture
- musical equipment
- art
- diy tools and supplies
- trinkets, paraphernalia, curiosities, oddities, kitsch, bobs, bits.

We also need practical help with the build out, including (possibly):

- building a stage / curtain
- clearing the jungle out the back and the path to the back door
- securing the terrace with fencing
- stage lighting
- mens toilet
- lots of other stuff...
